quests.dispatcherQuestion: Coolant leak detected in core reactor tank 4. Input emergency routing code!
quests.hint: Route the response to containment locker alpha.
quests.explanation: Sealing the leak area immediately protects nearby personnel from hazardous fluid exposure.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Lithium battery thermal runaway in storage bay 3. Input safety shutdown code!
quests.hint: The code uses termination sequence number four.
quests.explanation: Cutting power to battery circuits stops dangerous heat buildup from spreading to adjacent cells.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Gas cylinder pressure overload in laboratory level 2. Input routing code!
quests.hint: Activate the pressure vent system.
quests.explanation: Venting excess gas safely returns tank pressure to within normal operating limits.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Team member exposed to toxic solvent in chamber 2. Input decontamination code!
quests.hint: Direct the worker to chemical shower room three.
quests.explanation: Chemical shower decontamination removes toxic solvents from skin before they absorb into the bloodstream.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Decompression injury reported at the landing dock airlock. Input recovery code!
quests.hint: Initiate pressure equalization mode.
quests.explanation: Gradually equalizing airlock pressure prevents further decompression trauma and stabilizes the patient.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Severe cardiac event on the sector assembly floor. Input response unit code!
quests.hint: Dispatch the defibrillator unit immediately.
quests.explanation: Defibrillation within four minutes dramatically increases cardiac arrest survival rates.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Ground tremors shaking underground sector 7. Input lockdown protocol code!
quests.hint: Trigger lockdown protocol for sector seven.
quests.explanation: Locking down heavy drilling machinery during tremors protects crews from equipment collapse and falling debris.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Water levels rising in deep drainage ducts. Input bypass code!
quests.hint: Open the drainage valve at phase two.
quests.explanation: Phase 2 valve opening routes floodwater away from the main elevator shaft before it becomes submerged.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Heavy rock fall blocking the main entry passage. Input clearing unit code!
quests.hint: Dispatch the excavator robot unit.
quests.explanation: Robotic excavators clear debris safely without exposing rescue workers to secondary collapse risks.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Overload sparks on the primary transformer grid. Input shutdown code!
quests.hint: Select grid shutdown switch beta.
quests.explanation: Shutting down the beta grid prevents electrical fires from spreading through the surrounding cable network.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: High-voltage flash near the turbine generator. Input standby code!
quests.hint: Flip the auxiliary generator switch.
quests.explanation: Switching to the auxiliary generator protects the local grid from a complete blackout during turbine failure.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Solar electromagnetic storm warning detected. Input shielding code!
quests.hint: Deploy the electromagnetic shield now.
quests.explanation: Electromagnetic shields protect digital servers and control systems from solar storm-induced power surges.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Seawater hull breach detected in bilge compartment 12. Input response code!
quests.hint: Engage the automatic bilge compartment seal.
quests.explanation: Activating the automatic bilge seal isolates the breach and keeps the vessel afloat.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Oil separator tank high-pressure alarm activated. Input relief code!
quests.hint: The relief system prevents separator pipe ruptures.
quests.explanation: Releasing trapped pressure through the relief valve prevents catastrophic pipe failure and oil spill.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Deep-sea diver has lost radio contact. Input search and recovery code!
quests.hint: Use sonar locator at frequency four.
quests.explanation: Active sonar emits pulses that bounce off the diver's equipment, allowing the team to pinpoint the exact location.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Hydraulic system failure on passenger aircraft 7. Input landing gear code!
quests.hint: Trigger the emergency landing gear release.
quests.explanation: Emergency manual gear release deploys landing gear mechanically, allowing safe landing without hydraulic pressure.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Engine fire warning light active on jet airliner. Input suppression code!
quests.hint: Activate the halon fire extinguisher system.
quests.explanation: Halon agents displace oxygen inside the engine nacelle, extinguishing the combustion reaction within seconds.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Cabin decompression at 30,000 feet. Input passenger oxygen code!
quests.hint: Deploy the passenger oxygen masks immediately.
quests.explanation: Oxygen masks preserve passenger consciousness during cabin decompression above safe altitude thresholds.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Cyber attack detected on water treatment control systems. Input isolation code!
quests.hint: Engage the network isolation shield.
quests.explanation: Network isolation severs the attack vector from water treatment controls, preventing tampering with chemical dosing.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: DDoS attack overloading the emergency communications tower. Input filter code!
quests.hint: Initiate the traffic diverter protocol.
quests.explanation: Traffic diversion reroutes legitimate communications around the overloaded point, keeping emergency lines functional.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Intruder detected in the central server room. Input physical lockdown code!
quests.hint: Activate server area containment immediately.
quests.explanation: Physical containment prevents the intruder from accessing hardware to extract data or install backdoors.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Radiation shield door open in the radiography chamber. Input containment code!
quests.hint: Seal the radiation containment door now.
quests.explanation: Lead-reinforced containment doors absorb radiation and prevent high-level exposure from leaving the chamber.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Heavy isotope temperatures rising rapidly. Input cooling code!
quests.hint: Open the coolant dump valve immediately.
quests.explanation: Flooding the chamber with coolant rapidly absorbs residual heat, preventing thermal runaway.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Particle accelerator beam misalignment detected. Input emergency halt code!
quests.hint: Trigger the beam shutdown signal now.
quests.explanation: Cutting accelerator power stops the beam instantly, preventing it from melting through misaligned target components.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Avalanche warning detected on mountain rail tracks. Input divert code!
quests.hint: Activate the track divert signal now.
quests.explanation: Diverting train paths away from avalanche zones protects passengers from heavy snow impact and burial risks.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Maglev train speed governor has failed. Input emergency braking code!
quests.hint: Initiate the emergency braking system.
quests.explanation: Auxiliary magnetic brakes decelerate maglev coaches safely when the primary speed governor fails.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Landing gear stuck on cargo transport aircraft. Input runway safety code!
quests.hint: Activate the foam runway shield.
quests.explanation: Runway foam coating cuts ignition sparks during a metal belly landing, reducing the risk of fire on impact.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Severe space radiation storm detected near the station. Input shielding code!
quests.hint: Activate the shield deflector battery.
quests.explanation: Magnetic deflector arrays protect crew from high-energy cosmic ion bombardment during solar radiation events.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Micrometeoroid hull breach in the greenhouse module. Input airlock code!
quests.hint: Engage airlock console secure mode.
quests.explanation: Sealing the airlock isolates the breached module and preserves the oxygen supply in adjacent crew habitation areas.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: High fuel line pressure detected in the lunar propulsion system. Input vent code!
quests.hint: Open the fuel vent valve immediately.
quests.explanation: Releasing excess pressure from fuel lines prevents catastrophic rupture or ignition during launch preparation.
